issue.title: test_agent_output_variables_multi_agent PNG test intermittently loses the OUTPUT VARIABLES heading
issue.description:
`tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents.py::test_agent_output_variables_multi_agent_png_snapshot`
is intermittent: the `OUTPUT VARIABLES` heading is sometimes missing from the capture. It
passed during a full-suite golden update and then failed when run alone or scoped on the
same tree.

Proposed by sase-1ab.4 note #3 item 4 (the heading path was untouched by the turn
rename). Capture the failing render, find the race (likely the output-variable load
finishing after the snapshot waits), and make the test wait on the right condition.

task_type_fields.evidence: sase-1ab.4 note #3: passed during the full-suite visual update, then failed when run solo and scoped on the unchanged tree; heading render path untouched by the turn rename.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1ab.4 note #3 item 4: it passed in a full golden update and failed solo on the same tree, and no bead tracks it.

evidence.note: sase-1b1.4 note #4 (deck-view chrome phase, 2026-09-27): test_agent_output_variables_multi_agent failed its OUTPUT VARIABLES content assertion during the phase's visual runs, identically on the stash-verified clean base tree. The phase changed no output-variable code.

Independent repro by sase-1ex.land at master 9f8c4c529e (2026-10-03): just test-visual -- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents.py::test_agent_output_variables_multi_agent_png_snapshot failed solo twice in a row with AssertionError at _ace_agents_png_snapshot_helpers.py:164 (assert_page_svg_contains(page, 'OUTPUT VARIABLES')). sase-1ex.11--2 (note #3) had also seen 'agents multi-agent PNG golden' fail in a full just check and pass in isolation.
